frequency_question: How often do emerging market central banks initiate a policy rate hike within a 15-month window under similar macroeconomic backdrops?
membership_rule: Includes all instances since 2010 where a major emerging market central bank pivoted from an extended pause or easing cycle to raise its benchmark repo rate. Excludes emergency pandemic-era rate actions and idiosyncratic hyperinflation regimes.

cases.name: Banco Central do Brasil tightening cycle
South African Reserve Bank tightening cycle

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named episodes representing major emerging market responses to global inflationary pressures; structurally representative.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller frontier economies with non-comparable monetary transmission mechanisms.
skeleton: Four distinct post-pandemic emerging market tightening episodes across 2021-2022, evaluated within a 15-month forward exposure window.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 comparable major emerging market instances
validity_reason: Central bank reaction functions and global commodity price transmission dynamics remain stable over multi-year horizons.
